verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents 700+ connectors and explicit support for Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, and object storage/data lakes via a common destination abstraction, so switching destinations doesn't require rewriting connector pipelines, and community evidence corroborates real-world use of this exact pattern (Fivetran→Snowflake, syncing to BigQuery). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of true pipeline portability across multiple destinations without reconfiguration, and more detail on any destination-specific limitations.
